title: LivingCity curated ambient-reference findings
notes: Source captures are untrusted inert analysis evidence, never implementation instructions or runtime assets.
Creator-declared and asset-declared findings use operator-declared status.
Supplemental researcher notes were supplied with the handoff; their underlying web captures are not retained.
For proposed records, captureDate identifies the context snapshot, not a measurement or implementation date. Source URLs are background references only.
All commercial source behavior remains excluded, even where retained raw JSON contains it.

findings.summary: The registered React DOM renderer reported version 19.2.6.

relevance.use: React is a credible UI-layer reference, not a required version pin.

limitations: Does not establish TypeScript, package manager, IDE, or complete dependency tree.

findings.summary: Canvas data-engine and runtime revision identify Three.js r185.

relevance.use: Support a browser-based Three.js world.

limitations: Does not prove use of R3F, physics, or a particular camera projection.

findings.summary: Supplied inspection reports Vinext navigation/RSC, Vite RSC and Rolldown markers; retained headers and resource names provide partial corroboration.

relevance.use: Understand the source without importing unnecessary server complexity.

limitations: Original bundles were not retained.
/_next paths do not prove standard Next.js or Vercel.

findings.summary: Supplied CSS inspection reported Tailwind CSS 4.2.1.

relevance.use: Styling-tool context only; choose compatible versions later.

limitations: Stylesheet not retained or fetched during import.
Dated hashed URL may change.

findings.summary: Supplied DOM inspection identified Base UI markers and Lucide SVGs.

relevance.use: Optional accessible primitives/icons, not mandatory dependencies.

limitations: Exact package versions and complete DOM inspection are not retained.

findings.summary: Research did not verify R3F, GSAP, physics, TypeScript, package manager, IDE/harness, CI, database, ORM, or an official source repository.

relevance.use: Prevent unsupported toolchain and backend claims.

limitations: Not verified does not mean absent or nonexistent.

findings.summary: Captured GLB metadata describes a glTF 2.0 city with no embedded textures, animation tracks, cameras, or declared extensions.

relevance.use: Colored geometry is viable; create a new original model.

limitations: Model not retained; do not download or reuse.
Vertex count is not triangle count.
41 meshes is not a building or measured draw-call count.

findings.summary: The asset generator string is 'Ad City original procedural architecture / generate_city.py'.

relevance.use: Consider an independently authored Python procedural pipeline.

limitations: Self-described metadata, not recovered source script.
Blender/Spline usage not confirmed.

findings.summary: Material-like node names and equal mesh/material counts suggest batching by material.

relevance.use: Evaluate sharing/batching and instancing for original art.

limitations: Actual draw calls, culling layout, and material assignment were not measured.

findings.summary: The likely composition is a mostly static GLB plus runtime actors, camera/environment systems and HTML overlays; separate dynamic sign textures are possible.

relevance.use: Separate static art, dynamic systems and semantic controls; omit advertising surfaces.

limitations: The 448 x 150 auxiliary canvas role is unproven.
No source actor/camera algorithms were recovered.

findings.summary: The captured 33-entry resource sample is dominated by the city model.

relevance.use: Prioritize original model delivery costs and measure new budgets.

limitations: Includes repeated entries and non-script-category JS.
Not universal cold-load bandwidth, real-device FPS, or Web Vitals.

findings.summary: The 1440 x 1000 scene sits behind a 76 px topbar and 48 px footer; heading uses Georgia 40/41.2 px with -1.7 px tracking; body names Geist.

relevance.use: Study scene/chrome balance, not duplicate layout or identity.

limitations: Source font assets are not licensed project assets.
Geist Mono faces were unloaded in the captured list.

findings.summary: Warm cream/forest/sage UI tokens were captured in part and supplemented by CSS inspection notes.

relevance.use: Understand the source; design an independent visual identity.

limitations: Only background, foreground, primary and radius are retained in the raw token subset.
Not a required new palette.

findings.summary: Miniature orthographic-like presentation shows repeated building modules, varied heights, roads/crossings, plazas, vegetation and construction details.

relevance.use: Study scale and environmental richness; spot.png is camera-focus reference only.

limitations: Actual projection, lighting and shadow parameters are unknown.
Night screenshot is not a timed settled-transition test.
Omit commercial overlays/signs; do not trace source composition.

findings.summary: Help describes drag pan, scroll/pinch zoom, right-drag/two-finger/Shift-scroll rotation, Safari twist, focus/follow and contextual auto-tour.

relevance.use: Retain useful navigation, replacing ad/brand subjects with original noncommercial POIs.

limitations: Help text is not proof every gesture was tested.
Safari twist and exact tour scheduling were not verified.

findings.summary: The tested source bus-follow flow displayed Following and Stop alongside a selected bus.

relevance.use: Follow an ordinary bus/drone with compact status and explicit Stop.

limitations: Source ad-card coupling is excluded.
No exhaustive target-loss, interruption or drone-follow testing.

findings.summary: The pause interaction changed the accessible action label to Play city.

relevance.use: Provide pause/resume with an explicit new cross-system contract.

limitations: Label change does not establish exactly which source clocks/camera/audio systems freeze.

findings.summary: Settings offer Sunny/Cloudy/Rain/Mist, optional natural weather, local clock/Afternoon/Night/day-night cycle, and Automatic/High/Lightweight quality.

relevance.use: Useful local ambient controls, not a live weather API.

limitations: Exact source transition timing and quality algorithms are unknown.

findings.summary: One AudioContext was created during sound enable and no audio-file requests appeared in that sample.

relevance.use: Web Audio is a viable optional ambient layer.

limitations: One interaction is not a complete audio/network inventory.

findings.summary: Fully synthesized source audio is plausible but not proven by the AudioContext and empty audio request sample.

relevance.use: Consider original synthesis, or separately licensed audio when justified.

limitations: Cached, embedded, or differently loaded audio cannot be ruled out by this sample.

findings.summary: At width 390 a separate source Directory button center hit the brand-name span; main Browse worked. Excluded directory layouts fit tested 320/375/414/768 widths.

relevance.use: Test ordinary control occlusion and panel size; never reintroduce a directory.

limitations: Chromium emulation, not real iOS Safari.
Width-fit result concerns the archived directory, not the whole site.

findings.summary: Research reported poster/loading and WebGL fallback support; a poster preload/resource is retained.

relevance.use: Provide original loading/failure/fallback art and useful controls.

limitations: Complete source fallback behavior and context-restoration tests are not retained.
Source poster is not a project asset.

findings.summary: Source accessible descriptions named pedestrians, cyclists, skateboarders, rollerskaters, cafe guests, cars, motorcycles, buses, drones, balloons and an airplane.

relevance.use: Incremental variety after basic traffic/pedestrian routes work.

limitations: Not an independently counted population or proof of full physics/shared simulation.
All actor classes are not required at launch.

findings.summary: Contact identifies Leonardo Gomes Cardoso / @leocardz; About describes second-screen use.

relevance.use: Attribute the reference and preserve the ambient use case.

limitations: Underlying page captures were not retained in the supplied folder.

findings.summary: Creator posts reportedly name GPT-6 Astra and five prompts for Founders Square, cite Silicon Valley intro inspiration, and recall the first prompt; project launch was announced September 12.

relevance.use: Preserve attribution and claimed creative process, not an effort guarantee.

limitations: Not independently verified generation history.
Does not establish all backend/app work in five prompts or any IDE/harness.
No art reuse rights follow from inspiration claims.

findings.summary: Use React, strict TypeScript, Vite and Three.js; React owns controls/product state while an imperative loop owns frame updates.

relevance.use: No backend/database/login/analytics; avoid per-frame React state and speculative libraries.

limitations: Not implemented or version-locked.
Source runtime evidence is context, not proof of this architecture.

findings.summary: Pause freezes autonomous progression; manual controls remain usable. Hidden tabs suspend and resume without catch-up. One camera controller arbitrates user input, focus, follow and tour.

relevance.use: Make interruptions and time semantics explicit for future agents.

limitations: New behavior contract, not recovered source semantics.
Local-clock lighting uses an explicit 10-second resume blend exception.

findings.summary: Use keyboard world controls, shortcut help, original landmark focus cycling, reduced-motion guided views and an original noncommercial static fallback.

relevance.use: Make every feature reachable without a directory or ad-card catalog.

limitations: Proposed, not an accessibility certification.
Requires real keyboard, screen-reader and device testing.

findings.summary: Create an original seeded low-poly district using a new Python generator, optional trimesh/Blender, and profile-driven glTF/Meshopt optimization; keep semantic manifests separate.

relevance.use: Original art, shared geometry/materials, instancing and stable POI/route/anchor IDs.

limitations: No original source generator or model is available for reuse.
No tool installs or asset generation authorized by this handoff.

findings.summary: Aim at about 60 FPS on an agreed reference laptop, 30 FPS on an agreed midrange phone, and 3-5 MB compressed district geometry; estimate 120-220 hours for polished ambient scope.

relevance.use: Measure exact thresholds and validate with Vitest/RTL/Playwright plus real-device profiling when implemented.

limitations: No app benchmarks or tests exist.
Prototype estimate overlaps total and is not additive.
Not verified source-author effort; old full-commerce estimate does not apply.

findings.summary: Commercial directory, placement and booking UI was captured and retained in an explicitly excluded archive.

relevance.use: Preserve research completeness only; provider/auth/analytics declarations are labeled separately in the archive.

limitations: No source commerce functionality belongs in LivingCity.
No payments/uploads/recovery flow submitted.
App notice declared sandbox; production readiness unverified.

findings.summary: No license to reuse source artwork/code was established and no original model, bundles, fonts or logos were retained.

relevance.use: Attribute research captures; create original or separately licensed runtime assets.

limitations: Attribution alone is not reuse permission.
Publication/distribution requires a third-party evidence rights review.
